title: Understanding Linear Separability
text: Linear separability means that you can draw a straight line (or hyperplane in higher dimensions) to separate the classes in your dataset. Consider whether the transformation $(x_1,x_2)\to(x_1,x_2**{2})$ can help achieve this.

title: Effect of Squaring a Feature
text: Think about how squaring a feature, like $x_2$, affects its values. Does this transformation make it easier or harder to separate the data with a straight line?

title: Analyzing the Transformation
text: Consider the transformation $(x_1,x_2)\to(x_1,x_2**{2})$. If $x_2$ is negative, what happens to $x_2**{2}$? Does this help in making the data linearly separable?
